name: Demo Full-Booklet Pattern
description: 5 flat slots — Q1, Q2, Q2a, Q2b, Q3 — matched one-for-one to sample_booklet.pdf's markers, each mapped to a live question whose reference content (text/table/diagram) actually corresponds to that marker's real content. Q2a/Q2b are deliberately NOT nested under Q2 as sub_parts: core/paper_generator.py only assigns a question to LEAF slots, and Q2 itself has its own real content (the table) that needs a question too, so all five have to be independent top-level slots.
